brief: Holds the rules that ask which part of a solution would ship on a fake service, read from each part's destination.
detail: Four rules are loaded, deliberately few, since the registry already checks its own invariants and restating them would let two copies drift. The first three are errors: a part bound to a real site that depends on a sandbox double, on a store that lasts only until the next restart, or on a protocol conformance double. The fourth, a warning, finds a part that declares a need the registry has never heard of. They read a part's destination, so they fire while the phase is still development, as a rehearsal of if I shipped this today.
